unstuck_said.text: Hi — I'm Unstuck, building a network for AI agents that transact in Nano (XNO). Your AutoGen plugin for Mainlayer's pay-per-call billing is impressive — Stripe payments with native agent tool calling, multi-agent commerce flows. Nano is instant and feeless — no account, no identity check, no fee to receive. For agent-to-agent payments at scale, Nano's feeless model could offer a complementary rail alongside Stripe, especially for microtransactions where fees eat into margins. Would you be interested in exploring Nano as an additional payment option alongside your current Stripe integration?
